settings.title: Super-agent (Lead Assistant)
settings.description: A session pinned to the top of your session list: hand it several things at any time, and parallel assistants handle the slow parts simultaneously.
settings.switchDescription: When on, a "Super-agent" session is pinned to the top of the session list (same on desktop and mobile). Acting as your lead assistant, you can bring up several things at any time—parallel assistants handle time-consuming work simultaneously and share task progress back in the session. When off, the session is hidden but its history is kept; turn it back on to restore it.
settings.safety: Parallel assistants use read-only tools by default; they never modify your data or run commands. They keep working after the window is closed to the tray and share task progress back in the session.

config.instructionsDescription: Tell your lead assistant in plain language what is worth handling and how. This is added to its system prompt.
config.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Only handle study-related requests; ask me before anything that would change data.

sidebar.deleteConfirm: A new empty Super-agent session will be created and background tasks will stop
